narrative.overview:
`space` borrows the craft discipline of Apple's system apps — Finder's restraint, Disk Utility's flat honesty, Photos' data-first framing — never their chrome, icons, or copy. The chrome is system furniture: neutral, slightly cool, hairline-divided, and deliberately quiet, so the treemap is the only region on screen with saturation and weight. The interface refuses the two defaults of the disk-tool category: the boxed card grid and the decorative dashboard with one big number and an accent.

Density is high and rhythm is tight (8pt base); every figure is tabular so numbers never jitter during live scans; every transition rides one motion curve. Light and dark are a matched pair, resolved from the same token names, never two themes.
keyCharacteristics: The treemap owns all color; chrome is greyscale plus one selection blue.
Hairline 1px separators do all dividing — no cards, no shadows on resting surfaces.
Geist + Geist Mono only, self-hosted, weight steps 400/500/600.
Tabular figures everywhere a number can change.
One spring curve (420ms) for navigation, one short curve (120ms) for state.

rules.name: The Chrome Greyscale Rule
rules.body: No saturated hue outside the treemap, its legend, and the selection blue. If chrome needs emphasis, it gets ink weight, not color.

rules.name: The Two-Channel Rule
rules.body: Every category carries a text label and Caches carries a hatch; color is never the only encoding.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any string that can change while on screen — sizes, counts, percentages, paths — is Geist Mono with tabular-nums. Proportional figures in a live readout are a defect.

rules.name: The Flat Resting Rule
rules.body: Shadows respond to state or float; a shadow on a resting, in-flow surface is a defect.

dos: Do separate regions with 1px hairlines and fill tone.
Do set every live figure in Geist Mono with tabular-nums.
Do keep the treemap as the only saturated field; let it fill its container edge to edge at the container's exact aspect.
Do carry every transition on cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) (navigation, 420ms) or cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.9, 0.3, 1) (state, 120ms).
donts: Don't add a second type family, or set a number that can change in proportional figures.
Don't put a shadow on a resting surface, or wrap a section in a card.
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, ambient glows, blinking dots, or any element whose only job is to look designed.
Don't return the orange "s" letter-tile badge in any form; the wordmark is lowercase `space`, set in type.
Don't encode a category by hue alone.
Don't add a delete affordance anywhere — the product is read-only by construction.
